description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeDetailedModel' used for serializing detailed employee information in the OrangeHRM system, including attributes for employee identification, job details, subunit, status, and supervisors. It uses annotations for API schema documentation with OpenAPI (OA) and implements normalization logic for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes detailed employee information for API responses, using entity Employee and annotations for API schema documentation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeDetailedModel with an Employee entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
